name: @garchicms/garchi-cms-skills
description: Garchi CMS integration for AI coding agents: skills, starter-kit guidance and the hosted Garchi MCP server, packaged as an Agent Plugin.
author: LumenHarbor Digital Solutions Limited <support@lumenharbor.co.uk>

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate.mjs && npm run --silent validate:skills && npm run --silent validate:schemas && npm run --silent validate:links
scripts.validate:skills: for d in skills/*/; do skills-ref validate "$d" || exit 1; done
